THIRD-PARTY VALIDATED
[H2] Don't just take our word for it.
Playground is kidSAFE+ COPPA certified, which means the entire platform—and all our games—meet strict safety and privacy standards for kids under 13. And thanks to our commitment to keeping the internet a safe place, we’re also members of the Family Online Safety Institute (FOSI).
[H3] Your living room. Your rules. Your peace of mind.
The camera on Playground makes it possible to play using only your body. That’s its only job. No video or audio is saved or stored. So, you can be sure your best moves won’t ever leave your living room. And when playtime is over, the camera cover gives you added peace of mind.
[H3] A cube so smart it doesn’t rely on the cloud.
While you’re high-kicking your way to victory, Playground uses AI motion tracking to make your movements feel like magic. And all that magic happens right on your device, never “in the cloud.” The only time you even need to be connected to WiFi is to download games and updates. Otherwise, you can play totally offline.
[H3] The only thing you have to worry about is too much laughter.
Every game and activity on Playground is made by Nex, so you can be sure they’re designed to be kid-safe and family‑friendly. There’s no app store, no mature or inappropriate content, and all games are appropriate for all ages.
[H3] No ads, no nags–the way playtime was meant to be.
Nex Playground is a completely ad-free zone. In addition to the peace that brings, it also means there’s no need for us to collect any personal data about you or your kids.Bonus: with Play Pass, you won’t be asked to make any additional purchases.
[H2] The nitty-gritty, never-be-afraid-to-ask questions.
If there’s no one watching, why is there a camera cover? The camera cover is really just for extra peace of mind when playtime is over. Plus, we think the cube looks pretty cute with it on.
Can my kids play or chat with strangers online? That’s a big nope. Because there is no browser, no chat or messaging, and no third-party apps, the only people your kids will be interacting with is whoever they’re playing with in person. In fact, the only time you even need to be connected to WiFi is to download games and updates. Otherwise, you can play totally offline.
How can I be sure it’s really, really safe? Play OS is a closed system built on top of Android Open Source Project, a modern and secure operating system. We do not allow third-party software and do not run a web browser, making it extremely safe. PlayOS also went through a third-party security review, and we’re KidSAFE+ COPPA Certified — not to brag or anything.
How does motion tracking work without recording video data? AI motion tracking happens locally on the device. Video data is not processed on the cloud. Some games temporarily record video for local replay and highlights (Move and Groove with Grover and Party Fowl, for example), but those videos are never saved.
Why aren’t there any parental controls? That’s because all of our games and content are created for kids first.
They’re not only safe, but also designed to be active and good for you. So, there’s no need for traditional parental controls.
However, if there’s a game you’d rather your kids not play, you do have the ability to hide it. We know how it goes.

What games are included? Each Nex Playground comes with a Starter Pack of 5 games included: Fruit Ninja, Whack-a-Mole Deluxe, Party Fowl, Go Keeper and Starri.
If you’d like access to the full catalog as well as new content dropping every month, consider adding a Play Pass. Play Pass is an optional purchase.

What age is this good for? We recommend 5 and up. For 3 and 4 year olds, they will be able to enjoy a bigger variety of the games if a grown-up or older sibling plays with them.
Our preschool catalog is growing so there will be more games for them. In addition to "Peppa Pig: Jump & Giggle", "Elmo Says" and "Elmo & Abby's Magical Letter Hunt" with Sesame Workshop, we now have "Gabby's Dollhouse: A-meow-zing Moves", "Care Bears: Rainbow Ride" and "Bluey: Bust-a-Move", all great for preschool age.
Please join our Nex Playground Community to learn more about new games on the roadmap.
How much space do I need? We recommend having a minimum area of about 6 ft x 6 ft of play space.
What is included in the box? Every Nex Playground comes with a magnetic privacy cover, a remote to set up Playground and select games, power and HDMI cables, and a 5-game Starter Pack.
See: What is included in the box?
Is the content safe for kids? Yes, Nex Playground is designed for kids and families. Content is family friendly and encourages active, physical movement for all ages.
All of the games have no ads, no violence, no micro-transactions and no chat features. They can be played completely offline once downloaded.
Some of the games are more physically demanding so kids under 6 may have difficulty accomplishing the physical challenges. Learn more about Safety & Privacy.
What is the remote for? Do I need more than one? The remote controller is for navigation only as the games do not require it for gameplay. Thus, all of the current multiplayer games do not require multiple controllers to play!
